title: Metrus: Pandemic
description: My version of the ideal zombie apocalypse modpack
body:
My idea of the best zombie apocalypse modpack

made to look like you're the last person alive on an abandoned world
with additions like Lost Cities world type, extra biomes, SecurityCraft for creating the best base, and the best shaders i could find


this modpack is designed to hopefully fit for everyone that plays it, with all in game options unlocked to allow a user to customize their experience

this modpack is also multiplayer compatible so feel free to take on the apocalypse with friends, or brave the world alone

the best shaders that were configured to best fit the theme of the modpack are ones like Complimentary Reimagined + Euphoria Patches, Insanity, and Hysteria
